title: Dolphyn machine learning improves PhIP-Seq libraries and finds gut phage antibodies
summary: Dolphyn uses machine learning to select peptides and compress proteomes by epitope stitching for phage immunoprecipitation sequencing. It raised the fraction of gut phage library peptides bound by antibodies from 10% to 31% in healthy individuals while using 78% fewer synthesized peptides, and the assays showed antibodies to bacteria-infecting gut phages, particularly E. coli-infecting Myoviridae. The antibody finding is assay-based and the machine learning role is library design. Preprint of 2023-07-31.
ai_technology: Dolphyn, a machine learning method selecting peptides and stitching epitopes for PhIP-Seq library design

evidence.tested: Experimental PhIP-Seq measurements of antibody binding in healthy individuals.
evidence.unknown: Cohort size, functional meaning of the antibodies and peer-reviewed status are not stated in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning designed the peptide library that enabled the antibody measurements.
